title: Income Annuities Free-Look Right to Return the Contract
content:
**Right.** The owner of an Ashgrove Income Annuities contract may return the contract for a refund of the purchase amount less income installments already paid.

**Time limit.** The returned contract must be received no later than the contract delivery date plus the free-look days. The free-look end is found by adding the free-look days in calendar days to the contract delivery date; a contract received on that day is in time.

- The clock starts from the contract delivery date shown on the contract record — the date the owner received the contract — not from the issue date or a date the owner recalls.
- The free-look days are counted as calendar days, not business days or full 24-hour periods.
- The comparison is "not later than": receipt on the free-look end day itself is in time; receipt on any later day is not.

**Which period applies.** When the purchase replaced another annuity, the tier's replacement free-look period replaces the free-look days; when the owner's age on the issue date (as recorded on the contract) was the tier's senior free-look age or more, the tier's senior free-look period replaces it; when both apply, the longer governs.

**Annuitized contracts.** A contract bought by annuitizing an Ashgrove deferred annuity may be returned the same way, and the refund is paid to the owner in cash; the deferred annuity is not restored.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Contract delivery date | Period that applies | Free-look end | Contract received | In time? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March | 10 days | 11 March | 11 March | Yes — received on the end day |
| 1 March | 10 days | 11 March | 12 March | No — the day after the end |
| 1 March | 30 days (replacement) | 31 March | 31 March | Yes |
| 1 March | 30 days (senior owner) | 31 March | 1 April | No |

**Refund example (hypothetical).** Purchase amount $80,000.00; one installment of $450.00 already paid: the refund is $79,550.00.
